limits: Apple .ips remains a native report; a manifest/PID/UUID-checked external sidecar adds logical guest and async segments. No fatal-signal handler or live runtime inspection.
Host failure completion returns a trap; it does not inject a catchable guest exception or unwind native exceptions through C.
No arbitrary live-Wasm sampling, JIT, or WAMR AOT suspension/source-snapshot qualification.
TinyWasm cached archives omit debug metadata; use original Wasm for source-qualified snapshots.
Physical Windows host 192.168.7.20 timed out; Windows evidence above is hosted CI.
No physical Watch/Pico evidence. QEMU is a Cortex-M33 model with scripted network readiness.
Process RSS and timing vary. Disabled-build section and dispatch comparisons accompany nine paired serial samples, rather than claiming exact equality of noisy samples.
